titleEn: Needs-your-team flag (handoff from the agent or bot)

en: Why did the agent go silent?

steps: Triggered by customer asking, agent unsure, no credits, service-menu "Talk to a person"
Take over, or reply; silence lasts the handoff period (default 120 min)
edgeCases: AI credits run out: the agent stops and hands the chat to staff
No owner alert exists on main (pr 79 adds notifyPhone)
Reasons stored as codes: asked, model, no_credits, misconfigured, provider_error, bad_output, no_answer, staff
gaps: On main the owner is NOT notified (only the inbox badge)
